spanish: Y verá el sacerdote, y he aquí se extendió la erupción en la piel, y lo impurecerá el sacerdote; lepra ella.

findings.issue: Qal perfect 3fs is an intransitive spread; Spanish se is reflexive smoothing that does not add a participant.
Morphology is a preposition plus an anarthrous noun; Spanish adds a definite article.

notes: Priest, behold, 3ms impurity declaration, and verbless lepra ella match the tokens.
